title: Debug React useEffect event listener leak — 3 turns
description: React hooks missing cleanup functions cause event listener and interval leaks. Fix them across turns.

task_spec.prompt: The `useWindowSize` hook in `src/useWindowSize.ts` adds a resize event listener but never removes it. Fix the useEffect to return a cleanup function: `return () => window.removeEventListener('resize', handler);`. Run `npm test -- --forceExit`.
followup_prompts: Run `npm test -- --forceExit` to check the current state. Walk me through what you fixed. Now fix `usePolling` in `src/usePolling.ts` — the setInterval is created but never cleared. Add `return () => clearInterval(id);` as the cleanup function. Run `npm test -- --forceExit` and fix any failures.
Final verification: run `npm test -- --forceExit` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — fix any failures now.
success_criteria: useWindowSize returns cleanup that calls removeEventListener
usePolling returns cleanup that calls clearInterval
